facts.text: A blind spot is any area around a machine that the operator cannot see from the seat; operator visibility is the overall picture of what the operator can and cannot see with eyes, mirrors and cameras.
facts.quote: A blind spot is any area around a machine that the operator cannot see from the seat, and operator visibility is the overall picture of what the operator can and cannot see with eyes, mirrors and cameras.

facts.text: The front-right blind area of a 50 t haul truck extends 18 m or more and grows with truck size.
facts.quote: The front-right blind area of a 50 t haul truck extends 18 m or more and grows with truck size

facts.text: Cab pillars, raised buckets and bulky loads create additional hidden zones around machines.
facts.quote: Cab pillars, raised buckets and bulky loads add more hidden zones.

facts.text: Blind areas are identified as the single most important factor in the deadliest collisions.
facts.quote: Blind areas are the single most important factor in the deadliest collisions.

facts.text: NIOSH counted 22 blind-area deaths in US surface mines from 2000 to mid-2006.
facts.quote: NIOSH counted 22 blind-area deaths in US surface mines from 2000 to mid-2006

facts.text: Dump trucks were involved in 38% of the 22 blind-area deaths counted by NIOSH in US surface mines from 2000 to mid-2006.
Front-end loaders were involved in 33% of the 22 blind-area deaths counted by NIOSH in US surface mines from 2000 to mid-2006.
Of the victims in the 22 blind-area deaths counted by NIOSH in US surface mines from 2000 to mid-2006, 67% were in the rear blind area of reversing equipment.
facts.quote: 67% of victims were in the rear blind area of reversing equipment

facts.text: ISO 5006 defines how to measure what a machine operator can see.
facts.quote: ISO 5006 defines how to measure what an operator can see

facts.text: ISO 16001 covers detection systems and visibility aids such as cameras and mirrors.
facts.quote: ISO 16001 covers detection systems and visibility aids such as cameras and mirrors

facts.text: Visibility-type methods associated with ISO 5006 and ISO 16001 allow blind zones to be computed for each machine model from its geometry before hardware arrives.
facts.quote: these visibility-type methods let blind zones be computed per machine model from its geometry before hardware arrives

facts.text: Both the existing warning system and the new braking system are intended to cover ground that the machine operator cannot see.
facts.quote: Both the existing warning system and the new braking system exist to cover the ground the operator cannot see.

facts.text: Validation scenarios should be built around each machine model's blind areas because those areas are where victims are located.
facts.quote: Scenarios should be built around where each machine model's blind areas are, because that is where the victims are.

facts.text: Blind-area geometry changes with every machine model and sensor position, which is one reason validation evidence does not transfer freely between machine models.
facts.quote: Blind-area geometry changes with every model and sensor position, one reason evidence does not transfer freely between models
